criteria_results.criterion_text: AC-3: `requests_served` is strictly greater on a second `GET /stats` than on the first (the counter counts).
criteria_results.evidence: StatsCounterMiddleware increments the counter on every request. Two sequential GET /stats calls show strictly increasing requests_served. Test: test_stats_counter_increases.

criteria_results.criterion_text: AC-4: `first_request_at` is identical across successive responses once set, and parses as UTC ISO-8601.
criteria_results.evidence: StatsState stores first_request_at on first increment and never changes it. Tests verify identical values across responses and valid UTC ISO-8601 parsing. Tests: test_stats_first_request_at_consistent, test_stats_first_request_at_parses_utc_iso8601.

criteria_results.criterion_text: AC-5: On a freshly constructed app, the first `GET /stats` response reports `requests_served >= 1` and a non-null `first_request_at` (ASSUM-002: the in-flight statistics request is included in its own count).
criteria_results.evidence: Each fresh app instance starts with counter at 0; the in-flight GET /stats request increments it to 1 before the handler reads it. Tests: test_stats_first_request_served_ge_1, test_stats_first_request_first_request_at_not_null.

criteria_results.criterion_text: AC-6: Every handled HTTP request increments the counter regardless of route or outcome — a request to an existing non-stats endpoint and a request yielding a client error both increase `requests_served` (ASSUM-003, middleware-level counting).
